items.abstract: Herbivores can vary in their relative requirements for nutrients and carbon, with important consequences for consumer-resource dynamics and nutrient cycling. The nutrient (phosphorus) and carbon requirements of herbivore growth have both been found to increase at temperature extremes, yet the consequences of these thermal responses for herbivore-autotroph population dynamics have not been explored. Here, we develop and analyze a stoichiometrically-explicit, temperature-dependent model of herbivore-autotroph systems to evaluate how these two thermal responses of herbivore nutritional traits affect population responses to temperature and phosphorus supply. We find contrasting effects of increased phosphorus or carbon demands at temperature extremes. Increases in herbivore phosphorus demands relatively strongly restricts the range of temperatures at which the herbivore population persists and slightly decreases the stability of population dynamics at high phosphorus supplies. In contrast, increases in the carbon requirements of herbivore growth slightly decreases the temperature range supporting herbivore persistence and stabilizes the system under phosphorus enrichment. These contrasting effects of herbivore nutrient and carbon demands reflect differences in the ecological contexts at which they influence herbivore performance. Increased nutrient requirements impair herbivore productivity near the herbivore persistence boundary where autotrophs are abundant and nutrient-poor, whereas high carbon demands decrease herbivore productivity near the stability boundary where autotrophs are at low density and nutrient-rich. The thermal response of herbivore nutritional traits may therefore be an important factor influencing population responses to warming and nutrient enrichment.
items.authors: Anderson, D. M.; Laid-Low, F. F.; O'Connor, M. I.

items.title: Evolutionary branching under slowly evolving constraints
items.abstract: Biological populations have been evolving in multi-dimensional trait spaces. Ecological interactions can induce the evolutionary diversification of a biological population into distinct multiple populations, which is called evolutionary branching in adaptive dynamics theory. If possible mutations are restricted to certain directions due to developmental, physiological, or physical constraints, the resulting evolutionary dynamics may be restricted to subspaces with fewer dimensions than the original trait spaces. In general, such constraints are also evolving slowly, due to rare and slight mutational deviations from the constraint subspaces. In this sense, constraints are not strict. However, the method for describing non-strict constraints that is globally consistent has yet to be developed. This study proposes a general and flexible method for constructing a non-strict constraint subspace from the corresponding strict constraint subspace. This method enables efficient analysis of adaptive evolution including evolutionary branching under non-strict constraints in the framework of adaptive dynamics theory. Applying this method to a resource competition model shows that the shape of the carrying capacity distribution can be treated as a non-strict constraint curve, and that the likelihood of evolutionary branching is affected not only by the shape of the constraint curve but also by its slow evolution.
items.authors: Ito, H. C.

items.title: Systematic screen of PKR reveals genetic variants that broadly evade divergent viral pseudosubstrate inhibitors
items.abstract: Evolutionary arms races can arise at the contact surfaces between host and viral proteins, producing dynamic spaces in which genetic variants are continually pursued even while protein function must be maintained. A striking case is protein kinase R (PKR), an innate immune protein that detects viral replication and halts protein synthesis by phosphorylating the initiation factor eIF2. PKR is targeted by many viral antagonists, including pseudosubstrate inhibitors encoded by poxviruses and ranaviruses that mimic eIF2. We previously found that the eIF2-binding surface of human PKR is highly malleable against the vaccinia virus pseudosubstrate inhibitor K3. Here, we screen our library of SNP-accessible PKR variants against five viral inhibitors of increasing divergence: K3 orthologs from vaccinia, variola, tanapox, and myxoma viruses, and the independently derived vIF2 from Rana catesbeiana virus Z. Resistance-conferring variants are readily accessible against every inhibitor tested and are often shared across phylogenetically diverse K3 orthologs and the ranavirus inhibitor, suggesting that PKR escape variants can exploit features common to pseudosubstrate inhibitors. Many variants beneficial against multiple inhibitors correspond to sites under positive selection across vertebrates. Inhibitor-specific effects are largely explained by differences in contact residues between PKR and each inhibitor. Notably, no PKR variant became newly susceptible to myxoma K3, which does not naturally inhibit human PKR. The eIF2-binding surface of PKR is thus broadly navigable against genetically diverse viral pseudosubstrate inhibitors, potentiating its evolutionary capacity to combat viral inhibition without incurring new vulnerabilities.
items.authors: Chambers, M. J.; Grieve, T. R.; Scobell, S. B.; Sadhu, M. J.
items.title_zh: 系统筛选PKR揭示广泛逃避病毒伪底物抑制剂的遗传变异
items.summary_zh: 宿主与病毒蛋白之间的进化军备竞赛会产生动态空间，遗传变异在维持蛋白功能的同时不断被追求。蛋白激酶R（PKR）是一种先天免疫蛋白，通过磷酸化起始因子eIF2来检测病毒复制并停止蛋白合成。PKR受到多种病毒拮抗剂的靶向，包括模仿eIF2的伪底物抑制剂。我们筛选了PKR变异库，针对五种不同的病毒抑制剂进行测试，发现每种抑制剂均可获得抗性变异，这些变异在不同的K3同源物和ranavirus抑制剂中共享，表明PKR逃逸变异可能利用伪底物抑制剂的共同特征。许多对多种抑制剂有益的变异与脊椎动物中的正选择位点相对应。抑制剂特异性效应主要由PKR接触残基的差异解释。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现PKR的遗传变异使其能够逃避多种病毒伪底物抑制剂，这些变异在不同病毒中共享，揭示了宿主与病毒之间的进化适应关系。
items.l2_summary:
在宿主与病毒之间的进化军备竞赛中，遗传变异不断被追求，以维持蛋白功能。蛋白激酶R（PKR）作为一种重要的先天免疫蛋白，能够通过磷酸化起始因子eIF2来检测病毒复制并停止蛋白合成。然而，许多病毒通过伪底物抑制剂来对抗PKR的作用，这些抑制剂模仿eIF2的结构。为了深入了解PKR的逃逸机制，我们构建了PKR变异库，并针对五种不同的病毒抑制剂进行了系统筛选测试。结果显示，每种抑制剂均能诱导出抗性变异，这些变异在不同的K3同源物和ranavirus抑制剂中具有共享性，表明PKR的逃逸变异可能利用了伪底物抑制剂的共同特征。

进一步分析发现，许多对多种抑制剂具有抗性的变异与脊椎动物中的正选择位点相对应，表明这些变异可能在进化过程中被选择保留。抑制剂特异性效应的差异主要可以通过PKR接触残基的不同来解释。这项研究揭示了PKR在应对病毒伪底物抑制剂时的遗传变异特征，强调了宿主与病毒之间复杂的相互作用及其在进化中的重要性。这些发现为理解病毒如何逃避宿主免疫反应提供了新的视角，并可能为开发新的抗病毒策略提供理论基础。

items.title: This must be the place: deep learning local adaptation
items.abstract: Climate change is increasingly disrupting the relationship between locally adapted populations and the environments in which they evolved, creating an urgent need for tools that connect genomic variation to climate. Common-garden and provenance trials remain the gold standard for characterizing local adaptation, but their time and resource requirements limit how broadly they can be applied. Genomic approaches provide a complementary path. Genotype--environment association (GEA) methods identify environmentally associated loci. Machine-learning models have also shown that geographic origin can be predicted directly from genotypes. Here we introduce EcoLocator, a supervised deep neural network that jointly predicts geographic location and climate of origin from genotypes. Through extensive simulations we demonstrate that EcoLocator accurately recovers geographic location and environment of origin from genotype data, and, with SHAP-based feature attribution, identifies adaptive loci more reliably than benchmark GEA methods. We apply our method to coastal Douglas-fir (Pseudotsuga menziesii var. menziesii), where EcoLocator predicts geographic origin (R2=0.75--0.83) and climate of origin (R2=0.52--0.72) under leave-one-out cross-validation. Notably, we find that climate predicted directly from genotypes outperforms climate inferred by first predicting geographic origin, showing that EcoLocator captures genotype--climate signal that cannot be recovered from geography alone. Our prediction errors fall within the tolerances used in existing seed-transfer guidelines, demonstrating that EcoLocator's predictions are ready for practical application, and our approach is readily extendable to other species and conservation contexts.
items.authors: Rodriguez, J.; Cronn, R. C.; Tittes, S.; Kern, A. D.

items.title: In which cases does it make sense to classify an individual into one population and what are the alternatives?
items.abstract: During biogeographical ancestry (BGA) analysis, an unknown individual for whom ancestry informative markers (AIMs) were analyzed is often assigned to one of a few reference populations. For some individuals, such an assignment is not meaningful: the two parents of the individual may come from different populations, or the individual may come from a population not included in the reference database. In this study, we examined classification methods in combination with 104 AIMs from the VISAGE Enhanced Tool to provide one of the following three possible outcomes: (i) in-reference (IR), with an assignment to one of the reference populations; (ii) admixed (AD), with parents from two in-reference populations; and (iii) out-of-reference (OR), where the individual's ancestry is not sufficiently represented by the reference populations. We therefore compared seven classifiers in combination with class-specific acceptance thresholds for the OR decision. The best-performing method according to our selection criterion was a naive Bayes classifier over pairs of populations, which we call the recent naive Bayes (RNB) classifier. Populations held out of the reference panel were correctly rejected in $84.9\%$ of cases. We further tested the method on $800$ individuals from seven additional groups not included in the reference panel. Only $29.4\%$ of individuals from four non-admixed populations were rejected, resembling joint ancestry with reference populations. In addition, we investigated the prediction accuracy in a newly collected dataset of 28 individuals with self-reported ancestry by analyzing AIMs using massively parallel sequencing.
items.authors: Schmitz, J.; Naue, J.; Hoffmann, L.; Lange, Z.; Suchanek, F.; Lutz-Bonengel, S.; Dette, H.; Pfaffelhuber, P.; Heinzel, C. S.

items.title: Design and Evolution of an Orthogonal HaloTag for Multiplexed Labeling in Cells
items.abstract: The self-labeling protein HaloTag is used to install a wide variety of functional small molecules in cells and living organisms with exquisite specificity with respect to cell type and subcellular localization. HaloTag is a core part of many biotechnology-based tools for sensing, tracking, and manipulating biological systems with a high degree of spatial and temporal control. Due to the limitations of fluorescent proteins and other self-labeling proteins, most of these tools have historically been restricted to a single channel. In this work, we used structure-guided rational design and directed evolution to produce an orthogonal HaloTag protein called OrthoTag which reacts selectively with a modified chloroalkane substrate. OrthoTag retains many of HaloTag's superior properties, and reaction rate measurements with purified proteins show OrthoTag and its substrate have 109-fold mutual orthogonality to HaloTag with respect to substrate concentration. We demonstrate the application of OrthoTag for multiplexed labeling experiments in mammalian cells with minimal optimization. Going forward, OrthoTag should be straightforward to incorporate into HaloTag-based systems to allow simultaneous measurement or manipulation of two biological targets or processes. The availability of multiple high-performance self-labeling proteins will enable the continued development of new multiplexed biotechnology methods.
items.authors: Goldberg, B. J.; Lampkin, B. J.; Stanten, S.; Stead, A. T.; Rabe, P.; Kritzer, J.
items.title_zh: 正交HaloTag的设计与进化用于细胞多重标记
items.summary_zh: 自标记蛋白HaloTag用于在细胞和生物体中以高度特异性安装多种功能小分子。HaloTag是许多生物技术工具的核心，能够高效感知、追踪和操控生物系统。由于荧光蛋白和其他自标记蛋白的局限性，这些工具通常仅限于单通道。本研究通过结构引导的理性设计和定向进化，开发了一种名为OrthoTag的正交HaloTag蛋白，能够选择性地与改良的氯烷烃底物反应。OrthoTag保留了HaloTag的许多优越特性，纯化蛋白的反应速率测量显示，OrthoTag与其底物在底物浓度方面对HaloTag具有109倍的互正交性。我们展示了OrthoTag在哺乳动物细胞中进行多重标记实验的应用，且优化需求最小。未来，OrthoTag应易于整合进HaloTag基础系统，以实现对两个生物靶标或过程的同时测量或操控。多种高性能自标记蛋白的可用性将促进新多重生物标记技术的发展。
items.l1_lead: 本研究开发的OrthoTag正交HaloTag蛋白能够实现细胞中的多重标记，具有极高的互正交性和优化需求最小的优势，推动新型生物标记技术的发展。
items.l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于正交HaloTag蛋白的设计与进化，旨在实现细胞中的多重标记。HaloTag作为一种自标记蛋白，广泛应用于细胞和生物体内，以高度特异性地安装多种功能小分子，成为众多生物技术工具的核心，能够高效感知、追踪和操控生物系统。然而，传统的荧光蛋白和其他自标记蛋白存在一定的局限性，通常只能在单通道中使用。为了解决这一问题，研究团队通过结构引导的理性设计和定向进化，开发了一种名为OrthoTag的正交HaloTag蛋白。

OrthoTag能够选择性地与改良的氯烷烃底物反应，并保留了HaloTag的许多优越特性。研究中对纯化蛋白的反应速率进行了测量，结果显示OrthoTag与其底物在底物浓度方面对HaloTag具有109倍的互正交性。这一显著的互正交性使得OrthoTag在哺乳动物细胞中的多重标记实验中表现出色，且优化需求最小，显示出其在实际应用中的潜力。

未来，OrthoTag有望与HaloTag基础系统无缝整合，从而实现对两个生物靶标或过程的同时测量或操控。这种多种高性能自标记蛋白的可用性将极大促进新多重生物标记技术的发展，为生物医学研究提供更为强大的工具和方法。通过这一研究，OrthoTag的引入不仅拓宽了自标记蛋白的应用范围，也为细胞生物学研究提供了新的视角和可能性。

items.title: AMP: An Automated Marker Based Motion Capture Processing Pipeline for Kinematic Trajectory Label Scrubbing and Gaps Filling
items.abstract: Marker-based optical motion capture remains the gold standard for kinematic analysis across biomechanical research. However, when tracking dynamic movements, severe occlusions often create missing data and noisy signals that require time-consuming manual cleaning. Existing automated methods usually rely on predefined skeleton models or need massive training datasets for machine learning solutions. This study presents the AMP: an automated marker based motion capture processing pipeline. The AMP is a fully analytical approach that uses hierarchical algorithms including 1) rigid-body constraint, 2) Kalman Filter state estimation and 3) kinematic pattern match to label markers and fill data gaps without manual human intervention. First, the algorithm identifies and removes mislabeling markers before any data scrubbing. During the data cleaning process, our hierarchical algorithm uses a translation-based step to track segments even when there are insufficient donor markers to form a full rigid body. To reconstruct missing marker trajectories, the pipeline initially uses Piecewise Cubic Hermite Interpolating Polynomial (PCHIP) interpolation for short marker gaps. However, the PCHIP creates massive spatial errors during long occlusions, the system automatically switches to rigid-body tracking for gaps over 40 ms. Results showed the pipeline drastically reduced processing time compared to manual human expert methods by 73.5%. In addition, the AMP kept spatial errors within 10 mm of the manual ground truth. By using this combined hierarchical approach to match marker processing accuracy, the pipeline provides a fast, general-purpose tool that fully automates data cleaning and saves hours of manual effort.
items.authors: Zhou, S.; Casey, R.; Walter, J.; Young, A. J.

items.title: Quantum Hamiltonian-Based Generative Modeling of Single-Cell Transcriptomics for Gene Regulatory Network Inference
items.abstract: We introduce a novel quantum Hamiltonian-based gene expression model (QHGM), a generative framework for modeling pseudotime-ordered single-cell gene expression data. In QHGM, gene interactions are encoded via a parameterized Hamiltonian, and the outcomes of quantum measurements provide a discrete representation of the gene expression profile. To learn the Hamiltonian parameters and infer gene regulatory networks (GRNs), we develop a scalable variational quantum algorithm for network inference (VQ-Net) based on empirical risk minimization. We derive finite-sample recovery guarantees for accurate parameter estimation, demonstrating polynomial scaling with the number of genes. Experiments on synthetic data demonstrate accurate GRN recovery, with VQ-NET achieving over 25% improvement in edge recovery and over 50% improvement in parameter-sign recovery compared to state-of-the-art classical methods. We further apply the framework to glioblastoma scRNA-seq data, where it identifies biologically plausible regulatory interactions associated with cancer progression, highlighting the potential of quantum-like modeling beyond classical probabilistic frameworks.
items.authors: Sohail, M. A.; Sudharshan, R. R.; Pradhan, S. S.; Rao, A.
items.title_zh: 基于量子哈密顿量的单细胞转录组生成模型研究
items.summary_zh: 我们提出了一种新颖的基于量子哈密顿量的基因表达模型（QHGM），用于建模伪时间排序的单细胞基因表达数据。在QHGM中，基因相互作用通过参数化哈密顿量编码，量子测量的结果提供了基因表达谱的离散表示。为学习哈密顿量参数并推断基因调控网络（GRNs），我们开发了一种基于经验风险最小化的可扩展变分量子算法（VQ-Net）。我们推导了准确参数估计的有限样本恢复保证，证明了与基因数量的多项式缩放关系。对合成数据的实验表明，GRN恢复准确，VQ-NET在边缘恢复上提高了25%以上，在参数符号恢复上提高了50%以上，优于最先进的经典方法。我们进一步将该框架应用于胶质母细胞瘤的scRNA-seq数据，识别出与癌症进展相关的生物学上合理的调控相互作用，突显了量子建模超越经典概率框架的潜力。
items.l1_lead: 我们提出的基于量子哈密顿量的基因表达模型在单细胞转录组数据分析中表现出优越性，成功识别与癌症进展相关的调控相互作用，展示了量子建模的潜力。
items.l2_summary:
本研究提出了一种新颖的基于量子哈密顿量的基因表达模型（Quantum Hamiltonian Gene Model, QHGM），旨在对伪时间排序的单细胞基因表达数据进行建模。在QHGM中，基因之间的相互作用通过参数化的哈密顿量进行编码，而量子测量的结果则为基因表达谱提供了离散表示。为了学习哈密顿量的参数并推断基因调控网络（Gene Regulatory Networks, GRNs），研究团队开发了一种基于经验风险最小化的可扩展变分量子算法（Variational Quantum Algorithm, VQ-Net）。该算法的设计不仅关注参数的准确估计，还提供了有限样本恢复的保证，证明了其与基因数量之间存在多项式缩放关系。

在对合成数据的实验中，QHGM展现出优异的性能，GRN的恢复准确性显著提高，VQ-Net在边缘恢复方面的提升超过25%，而在参数符号恢复方面则提高了50%以上，表现优于现有的最先进经典方法。这一结果表明，基于量子模型的算法在处理复杂的基因调控网络时具有明显的优势。

此外，研究还将该框架应用于胶质母细胞瘤的单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据，成功识别出与癌症进展相关的生物学上合理的调控相互作用。这一发现不仅验证了QHGM在实际生物数据分析中的有效性，也突显了量子建模在超越经典概率框架方面的潜力，预示着量子计算在生物信息学领域的广泛应用前景。通过这一研究，量子计算技术在基因表达分析中的应用得到了进一步的拓展，为未来的生物医学研究提供了新的思路和方法。

items.title: Defining transcriptomic niches in human fibrotic lung with multi-sample spatial transcriptomics analysis using the MAPLE algorithm
items.abstract: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is an age-related lung disease marked by patchy parenchymal fibrosis that disrupts gas exchange and leads to respiratory failure. Single-cell RNA-seq studies have revealed cellular heterogeneity in IPF, but the spatial contexts underlying alveolar epithelial cell loss, honeycomb cyst formation, and fibroblastic foci remain unclear, motivating comparisons based on multi-sample spatial transcriptomics (ST) across clinical and anatomical conditions. Here, we present a comprehensive pipeline for analyzing multi-sample lung ST data that accounts for experimental design, featuring the MAPLE algorithm to jointly identify cell-spot subpopulations and discover spatial biomarkers, with validation using 10X Xenium ST data. Our analysis reveals that IPF progression involves epithelial-to-mesenchymal state transitions and region-specific fibrotic programs, characterized by extracellular matrix remodeling in the upper lobes and B-cell-enriched immune niches in the lower lobes. We identify fibrotic regions with senescent cell (SnC) enrichment and demonstrate their spatial colocalization with aberrant basaloid niches.
items.authors: Jeon, H.; Allen, C.; Vanegas, N.-D. P.; Xie, J.; Ghobashi, A. H.; Rodriguez-Lopez, J.; Rosas, L.; Wang, C.; Cheng, H.; Chang, Y.; Shilo, K.; Ma, A.; Mora, A. L.; Rojas, M.; Ma, Q.; Chung, D.
items.title_zh: 利用MAPLE算法定义人类纤维化肺的转录组微环境
items.summary_zh: 特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种与年龄相关的肺病，表现为斑片状肺实质纤维化，干扰气体交换并导致呼吸衰竭。单细胞RNA测序研究揭示了IPF中的细胞异质性，但肺泡上皮细胞丧失、蜂窝状囊肿形成和成纤维细胞灶的空间背景尚不清楚。本研究采用多样本空间转录组学（ST）分析，结合MAPLE算法，识别细胞-斑点亚群并发现空间生物标志物，验证使用10X Xenium ST数据。分析结果显示，IPF进展涉及上皮-间充质状态转变和区域特异性纤维化程序，上叶表现为细胞外基质重塑，下叶则富含B细胞的免疫微环境。我们识别出富含衰老细胞的纤维化区域，并展示其与异常基底样微环境的空间共定位。
items.l1_lead: 本研究通过MAPLE算法揭示特发性肺纤维化中细胞异质性及其转录组微环境，发现上叶和下叶的区域特异性纤维化程序及衰老细胞的空间共定位。
items.l2_summary:
特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种与年龄相关的肺部疾病，其特征为斑片状肺实质纤维化，严重干扰气体交换并最终导致呼吸衰竭。尽管单细胞RNA测序技术揭示了IPF中存在的细胞异质性，但对于肺泡上皮细胞的丧失、蜂窝状囊肿的形成以及成纤维细胞灶的空间背景仍不够清晰。本研究采用多样本空间转录组学（Spatial Transcriptomics, ST）分析，并结合MAPLE算法，旨在识别细胞-斑点亚群及发现空间生物标志物，验证过程中使用了10X Xenium ST数据。

通过分析，研究发现IPF的进展涉及上皮-间充质状态转变和区域特异性纤维化程序。具体而言，上叶区域表现出明显的细胞外基质重塑，而下叶区域则富含B细胞，形成特有的免疫微环境。此外，研究还识别出富含衰老细胞的纤维化区域，并展示了这些区域与异常基底样微环境的空间共定位现象。这一发现为理解IPF的发病机制提供了新的视角，强调了细胞间相互作用及其在疾病进展中的重要性。通过MAPLE算法的应用，研究不仅揭示了IPF的复杂转录组微环境，还为未来的治疗策略提供了潜在的生物标志物和靶点。

items.title: A Metacell Model of Single Cell RNA-seq Counts Yields a Gaussian Mixture Model in PCA Space
items.abstract: Single cell RNA sequencing (scRNAseq) has revolutionized cellular biology over the past decade. At its most basic, a scRNAseq dataset is a cell by gene matrix with entries giving the transcription count of a particular gene in a particular cell. A common workflow applies log-normalization and z-scoring to the count matrix and then embeds the cells in a lower dimensional space using principal component analysis (PCA). A large number of computational tools use the PCA embedding as a starting point, but statistical models for the distribution of cells in the PCA space are lacking. As a result, many tools depend on ad-hoc assumptions that likely lead to signal loss. In this work, we address this gap using the metacell model, a statistical model of count matrices introduced by previous authors. We show that application of the workflow to count matrices generated under a metacell model yields PCA embeddings distributed as a Gaussian mixture model (GMM). To our knowledge, this is the first result connecting a statistical model of counts to the distribution of cells in PCA space. Our derivation depends on methods from random matrix theory (RMT) and we extend and establish connections between RMT and scRNAseq count matrices. We then use the predicted GMM to test the metacell model on 11 datasets. The predictions are accurate for counts generated by the metacell model but underestimate the variance of real cells for most of our datasets. We show that this error largely arises from gene correlations within metacells, which the metacell model does not capture. Some of our datasets are fit relatively well by the metacell model, suggesting that the fit of the metacell model to true datasets depends on sufficiently dense sampling. Finally, we show that the strength of noise in the PCA space varies significantly across metacells, suggesting that statistical modeling of PCA embeddings can improve existing downstream workflows. Our results provide a framework for deriving and testing statistical models of PCA embeddings from statistical models of counts and identify a limitation of the metacell description for scRNAseq datasets.

items.title_zh: 单细胞RNA测序计数的元细胞模型在PCA空间中产生高斯混合模型
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNAseq）在过去十年中彻底改变了细胞生物学。scRNAseq数据集本质上是一个细胞与基因的矩阵，矩阵中的条目表示特定细胞中特定基因的转录计数。常见的工作流程对计数矩阵进行对数归一化和z-score标准化，然后使用主成分分析（PCA）将细胞嵌入低维空间。然而，缺乏针对PCA空间中细胞分布的统计模型，导致许多工具依赖于临时假设，可能导致信号损失。本文使用元细胞模型填补这一空白，表明在元细胞模型下生成的计数矩阵应用该工作流程后，PCA嵌入呈现高斯混合模型（GMM）分布。这是首次将计数的统计模型与PCA空间中细胞分布联系起来。我们的方法依赖于随机矩阵理论（RMT），并扩展了RMT与scRNAseq计数矩阵之间的联系。我们使用预测的GMM在11个数据集上测试元细胞模型，结果表明对于元细胞模型生成的计数，预测是准确的。
items.l1_lead: 本文提出的元细胞模型将单细胞RNA测序计数与PCA空间中的高斯混合模型相结合，填补了统计模型与细胞分布之间的空白，验证了其在多个数据集上的有效性。
items.l2_summary:
单细胞RNA测序（scRNAseq）在过去十年中极大地推动了细胞生物学的发展，其数据集通常表现为一个细胞与基因的矩阵，矩阵中的每个条目代表特定细胞中某一基因的转录计数。尽管常见的分析流程对计数矩阵进行了对数归一化和z-score标准化，并利用主成分分析（PCA）将细胞嵌入低维空间，但在PCA空间中缺乏针对细胞分布的统计模型，导致许多分析工具依赖于临时假设，这可能会造成信号的损失。为了解决这一问题，本文提出了一种元细胞模型，表明在该模型下生成的计数矩阵经过上述工作流程后，其PCA嵌入呈现高斯混合模型（GMM）分布。这一发现首次将计数的统计模型与PCA空间中的细胞分布相联系，填补了这一领域的空白。

该研究依赖于随机矩阵理论（RMT），并扩展了RMT与scRNAseq计数矩阵之间的关系。通过在11个不同的数据集上测试预测的GMM，结果显示对于元细胞模型生成的计数，预测的准确性得到了验证。这一研究不仅为单细胞RNA测序数据的分析提供了新的统计基础，也为后续的细胞生物学研究提供了更为可靠的工具和方法。通过将元细胞模型与PCA空间中的细胞分布相结合，研究者们能够更准确地理解细胞间的异质性及其生物学意义，从而推动单细胞研究的进一步发展。

items.title: DensiTree 3: Making Sense of Pairs of Sets of Trees
items.abstract: Motivation: Tree sets appear naturally when performing model based phylogenetic analyses. When tracking host-parasite co-evolution, testing sensitivity of different model assumptions, or even just checking convergence of individual runs of the same analysis, the question arises: are a given pair of tree sets the same? And if they are not the same, how do they differ? Results: We provide DensiTree 3, an interactive tool for inspecting pairs of sets of trees that allow visualising both tree sets using a single panel. Incorporation of CCDs provide better summary trees, taxon orderings and extra functionality like rogue detection, making it easier to interpret tree samples. Furthermore, a clade comparison graph allows inspection of differences in clade support and clade heights linked to the double-DensiTree panel. Together, these visualisations of tree sets make it easy to identify potential differences in the tree sets and interactively inspect these differences. Furthermore, recent advances in conditional clade distributions (CCDs) to represent tree distributions have been incorporated in DensiTree 3, and the most visible part of the user interface has been updated for a more modern look. Availability: DensiTree 3 is freely available from https://cs.auckland.ac.nz/~remco/DensiTree/. The program is licensed under GPL and source code is available via the link above.

items.title: The Smac mimetic drug Xevinapant sensitizes triple negative breast cancer to radiotherapy-induced cell death in a TNFα dependent manner
items.abstract: Purpose: There is an unmet need in the treatment of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), as recurrence rates remain high; thus, novel treatment strategies are warranted to improve outcomes for patients. Smac mimetics (SMs) are small molecules that inhibit the inhibitors of apoptosis. In this study, we investigated the properties of the SM Xevinapant (AT406) as a radiosensitizer in TNBC. Methods: TNBC cell lines were treated with Xevinapant (AT406) in the presence or absence of ionizing RT and cell viability and apoptosis measured in vitro. Clonogenic assays were performed to confirm radiosensitization. We also assessed xevinapant radiosensitization in the presence of the Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF) cytokine, which has been shown to enhance SM-induced apoptosis. Radiosensitization mechanisms were further validated by western blotting, flow cytometry and cell cycle analysis. Results: We show that Xevinapant increased cell death in a panel of irradiated TNBC cell lines. In clonogenic assays, Xevinapant sensitized MDA-MB-231 cells to RT-induced cell death, and this was significantly enhanced in the presence of TNF, with a dose-enhancing factor (DEF) of 1.57. We also show that Xevinapant radiosensitization is mediated by TNF-dependent apoptosis. Conclusions: Xevinapant is a radiosensitizer that enhances RT-induced cell death in TNBC cells, and TNF is central to this process through activation of apoptosis. These results are promising for combining RT with Xevinapant to improve local control in TNBC.

items.title: Crowdsourcing AI solutions in early rehospitalisation as a pilot for healthcare regulatory sandbox
items.abstract: Background: The uptake of new digital and AI based technologies in the health care setting, including digital diagnostics, has been comparatively slower than in other sectors. This is a consequence of the complex legislature, lack of routine procedures for the secondary use of sensitive medical data. Inadequate level of education and incentives for different stakeholders prevents overcoming strong barriers, such as clinical workflow integration, and need for comprehensive eval uation of utility of interventions which requires multi-disciplinary collaboration effort. The paper presents a Re-hospitalization Challenge, organised by the European Digital Innovation Hub (EDIH)- AI4Health.Cro, a co-creation activity and an effective tool for overcoming the mentioned barriers for implementation of new AI technologies and overall innovation ecosystem build-up. Methods: Crowdsourcing challenges or hackathons are R&D strategies in which ad-hoc assembled competing teams collaborate on early-stage technology devel opment or research problem solving. Re-hospitalisation challenge, in our case, has had multiple facets: as a co-creation activity tasked with construction of an AI predictive model with the explanatory support and plausible business model for its deployment; it involved also extensive organisers effort: data anonymisation, provision of secure processing environment, and comprehensive assessment of solutions. The paper details the challenge structure and processes, from problem inception to execution and comprehensive evaluation of developed solutions. Results: As a co-creation effort in digital healthcare, the challenge provided results on multiple levels: (i) through tailored solutions based on real evi dence data, serving as benchmarks or prototypes for later deployment in practice; (ii) through sandboxing EHDS principles to enable secondary data use; (iii) as an ecosystem building event yielding ad-hoc collaborative teams and cross-disciplinary participative learning experience. Conclusions: Crowdsourcing innovation challenges are valuable digital health care ecosystem building tool that provides a number of direct and indirect 2 impacts, from providing valuable diagnostic prototypes for innovation elicitation, creation and transformation of startups, to streamlining secondary use of clinical data for research and innovation. Overall impact is also enhanced through raising the awareness and education of all stakeholders relevant for the translation of AI technologies and into routine clinical setting.

items.title: Empowering Singaporeans to better manage chronic heart failure: Protocol for a mixed-methods study
items.abstract: ABSTRACT Introduction The prevalence of chronic heart failure is increasing in Singapore and is associated with frequent hospitalisations, high costs, and impaired quality of life. Patient empowerment interventions for chronic diseases, which are structured approaches that enable patients to actively engage in and influence their care, have demonstrated promising effects on health-related outcomes. In chronic heart failure, however, many interventions focus on selected aspects of empowerment, and there remains limited synthesis of which approaches are most acceptable, preferred, and effective as comprehensive intervention packages. This protocol describes the methods for a study to identify an empowerment-based intervention for adults with chronic heart failure that is both contextually suitable and cost-effective in Singapore. Methods and analysis We will use a staged, sequential design comprising three objectives. Objective one is to conduct a systematic review and meta-analysis to synthesise international evidence of the effectiveness of empowerment-based interventions for adults with chronic heart failure. Objective two is to complete a mixed-methods study. Semi-structured interviews with patients and their caregivers, analysed using codebook thematic analysis, will identify empowerment-related needs, barriers and facilitators in local chronic heart failure care. Findings from the review and interviews will then inform a discrete choice experiment to elicit patients' preferences for features of an empowerment-based intervention, analysed using multinomial logit and latent class models. Objective three is to conduct a cost-effectiveness analysis of the selected intervention compared with usual care, using a decision tree and Markov model from the perspective of the Singapore health system. Ethics and dissemination Ethics approval for the qualitative study has been obtained from the SingHealth Centralised Institutional Review Board (ECOS Ref: 2025-1152); ethics approval for the DCE will be sought prior to recruitment. Findings will be disseminated through peer-reviewed publications and conference presentations. Registration details PROSPERO registration number: CRD420251249957; http://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO

items.title: Common Electrophysiology Biomarkers Collected at Home Robustly Track Depression Recovery With Deep Brain Stimulation
items.abstract: Subcallosal cingulate cortex (SCC) deep brain stimulation (DBS) can provide relief for individuals with Treatment Resistant Depression (TRD), but ongoing clinical management remains challenging due to nonspecific symptom fluctuations that can obscure core depression recovery on standard rating scales. Objective, stable biomarkers that selectively track the therapeutic effects of SCC DBS are therefore essential for developing principled decision support systems to guide stimulation adjustments. Recent bidirectional DBS systems enable chronic recording of local field potentials (LFPs) and prior work using the Activa PC+S device identified an electrophysiological signature of stable clinical recovery. However, translation to practical clinical deployment requires demonstrating that this biomarker is robustly generalizable, specific to the impact of the DBS therapy, and deployable in real-world recording contexts. To address this need, we developed an at-home SCC LFP data collection platform (built on the Medtronic Summit RC+S system) enabling at home data collection for a new cohort of ten SCC DBS participants with TRD (ClinicalTrials.gov identifier NCT04106466). Using longitudinal LFP recordings collected from this system, we report findings demonstrating that the previously reported biomarker of stable recovery generalizes across subject cohorts and devices without any model retraining, is robust to common potential confounds (including time of day and stimulation status), and shows symptom specificity, sensitivity and stability necessary to support clinical decision making. Across both cohorts, biomarker changes show relationships to pre-DBS white matter structure and network function measured using diffusion MRI and resting-state functional MRI (rsfMRI). These findings replicating and extending previous results support the biomarker's utility as a foundation for scalable, electrophysiology-informed decision support in SCC DBS.

items.title_zh: 家庭收集的电生理生物标志物有效追踪深脑刺激抑郁恢复
items.summary_zh: 亚胼胝体扣带皮层（SCC）深脑刺激（DBS）能够为难治性抑郁症（TRD）患者提供缓解，但由于症状波动，临床管理仍然具有挑战性。为了开发支持刺激调整的决策系统，亟需客观、稳定的生物标志物来追踪SCC DBS的治疗效果。我们开发了一个家庭SCC局部场电位（LFP）数据收集平台，针对10名TRD患者进行研究（临床试验注册号NCT04106466）。通过长期LFP记录，我们发现之前报告的稳定恢复生物标志物在不同受试者群体和设备间具有良好的普适性，且与DBS疗法的影响特异相关。
items.l1_lead: 家庭收集的电生理生物标志物能够有效追踪深脑刺激对难治性抑郁症患者的治疗效果，为临床管理提供了客观依据。
items.l2_summary: 亚胼胝体扣带皮层（SCC）深脑刺激（DBS）为难治性抑郁症（TRD）患者提供了缓解的可能性，但由于症状的波动，临床管理面临着诸多挑战。因此，开发一种能够支持刺激调整的决策系统显得尤为重要，而这需要客观且稳定的生物标志物来有效追踪SCC DBS的治疗效果。为此，研究团队开发了一个家庭SCC局部场电位（LFP）数据收集平台，并对10名TRD患者进行了研究（临床试验注册号NCT04106466）。通过对长期LFP数据的记录与分析，研究发现之前报告的稳定恢复生物标志物在不同受试者群体和设备之间展现出了良好的普适性，并且与DBS疗法的影响具有特异的相关性。这一发现为临床上对TRD患者的治疗提供了新的思路，表明家庭收集的电生理生物标志物能够有效追踪深脑刺激的抑郁恢复情况，从而为个性化治疗方案的制定提供了重要依据。研究结果不仅增强了对DBS疗法效果的理解，也为未来的临床应用提供了新的方向。

items.title: Pre-Infection Mental Health, but Not Brain Volumetry, Predicts Risk of Post-COVID Condition: A Population-Based Cohort Study in the German National Cohort (NAKO)
items.abstract: Background: Post-COVID Condition (PCC) affected 10-30% of individuals after SARS-CoV-2 infection, and pre-infection predictors of who goes on to develop it are not well established. We compared pre-infection structural brain variation and baseline psychiatric phenotype as candidate predictors of PCC within a common multi-modal framework in the German National Cohort (NAKO). Both are candidate "first hits" under the second-hit hypothesis, which motivates the comparison; this is a prediction study, not a test of that hypothesis. Methods: In 8,464 SARS-CoV-2-infected NAKO neuroimaging participants, of whom 2,304 (27.2%) met PCC criteria (weighted post-COVID syndrome (PCS) score > 10.75) and the rest were symptom-free controls, ten pre-infection modalities (T1-weighted volumetric brain MRI across six parcellations, baseline mental health (PHQ-9, GAD-7), demographics, and seven further biomedical and socioeconomic domains) entered a stacked ensemble with 10x5 nested cross-validation (primary metric: the area under the precision-recall curve, PR-AUC). Pre-specified analyses assessed transportability to a non-imaging cohort and robustness to the mental-health symptom trajectory and to unmeasured confounding. SARS-CoV-2 infection status and the PCC outcome were ascertained by self-report; no clinically confirmed diagnoses were available. Results: Baseline mental health, assessed 3-8 years before infection, was the strongest predictor (38.0% of feature importance; standalone ROC-AUC = 0.640), whereas all six brain-MRI parcellations performed at or near chance (ROC-AUC 0.496-0.516). The multi-modal model achieved moderate, well-calibrated discrimination (ROC-AUC = 0.665, 95% CI 0.653-0.677; PR-AUC = 0.413, 0.392-0.434; ECE = 0.013). A four-modality non-imaging version, applied without retraining to NAKO participants without MRI, retained discrimination (ROC-AUC = 0.660, 0.654-0.665), meeting all three pre-specified equivalence criteria, the calibration intercept narrowly. The baseline mental-health odds ratio was 2.06 (1.83-2.32; E-value 2.66) and essentially unchanged under an alternative control definition (2.07); adjusting for the full mental-health symptom trajectory reduced it to a conservative lower bound of 1.38 (1.20-1.58) that remained independently significant. Baseline mental health did not predict objectively measured hyposmia in participants screened before their infection (0.89) while predicting self-reported smell loss in the same participants (1.92). Conclusions: Baseline mental health years before infection is the strongest pre-infection predictor of PCC among the infected, and the association held across the pre-specified sensitivity analyses. Whether it acts specifically on COVID-19 sequelae is a separate question this design cannot answer, and the indirect evidence points away from specificity: the association is undiminished after mild infection but absent among the hospitalized, and baseline mental health predicts current mental-health symptom load slightly less strongly in infected than in non-infected participants. The volumetric structural candidate is not supported: pre-pandemic T1-weighted volumetry carried no predictive signal in this single neuroimaging cohort. Risk stratification may benefit from incorporating baseline psychiatric phenotype; whether treating it reduces PCC incidence requires interventional study.

items.title_zh: 感染前心理健康预测后COVID症状风险的研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：后COVID症状（PCC）在SARS-CoV-2感染后影响10-30%的人群，感染前的预测因素尚不明确。本研究比较了德国国家队列（NAKO）中感染前的脑结构变化和基线心理特征作为PCC的候选预测因子。方法：在8464名SARS-CoV-2感染的NAKO神经影像参与者中，2304名（27.2%）符合PCC标准，其他为无症状对照。研究使用十种感染前的指标（包括六个分区的T1加权脑MRI、基线心理健康（PHQ-9、GAD-7）、人口统计学及其他生物医学和社会经济领域），采用10x5嵌套交叉验证的堆叠集成方法。结果：基线心理健康与PCC风险相关，而脑容积测量未能预测PCC。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，感染前的心理健康状况与后COVID症状风险相关，而脑结构变化无法有效预测该风险。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了感染前的心理健康状况如何预测后COVID症状（PCC）的风险。后COVID症状是指在SARS-CoV-2感染后，约10-30%的人群会出现的长期健康问题。尽管PCC的发生率较高，但感染前的预测因素尚不明确。为此，研究团队分析了德国国家队列（NAKO）中8464名SARS-CoV-2感染者的脑结构变化和基线心理特征，以寻找PCC的潜在预测因子。在这8464名参与者中，有2304名（27.2%）符合PCC的标准，其余为无症状对照。

研究采用了十种感染前的指标，包括六个分区的T1加权脑MRI、基线心理健康评估（使用PHQ-9和GAD-7量表）、人口统计学信息以及其他生物医学和社会经济因素。为了确保结果的可靠性，研究团队使用了10x5嵌套交叉验证的堆叠集成方法进行数据分析。

结果显示，基线心理健康状况与PCC风险存在显著相关性，而脑容积测量未能有效预测PCC的发生。这一发现表明，感染前的心理健康状况可能是评估个体感染后发展PCC风险的重要因素，而脑结构的变化在这一过程中并没有表现出相应的预测能力。这项研究为理解PCC的发生机制提供了新的视角，强调了心理健康在感染前评估中的重要性。

items.title: Development and validation of polygenic risk profiles of schizophrenia
items.abstract: Understanding the genetic architecture of schizophrenia (SCZ) is invaluable for the development of personalized treatment. In three independent cohorts, using an automated pipeline, we calculated 413 psychiatry-relevant polygenic scores. Using these scores, machine learning was applied to stratify SCZ patients into two genetic risk profiles (GRP) in FinnGen (nSCZ=7 486), and to validate these results in the PsyCourse Study (nSCZ=419) and Bari (nSCZ=531). While the two GRPs showed comparable polygenic SCZ risk, they were primarily distinguished by a greater predisposition for neuroticism, depression-related traits, and lower cognitive performance in GRP 1. The genetic prediction of GRP 1 was phenotypically characterized by an increased prevalence of SCZ and a more severe and complex clinical manifestation. This illustrates that the penetrance of genetic SCZ risk might partially depend on the predisposition for the aforementioned traits through pleiotropic variants. Our results provide novel, replicable insights into the genetic architecture of SCZ and might inform future personalized treatments.

items.title: Comparison of a Novel Plethysmometric Method for Blood Pressure Estimation with Reference Sphygmomanometry
items.abstract: Abstract Background: Plethysmometry is a cuff based method that records photoplethysmographic pulse amplitudes at multiple cuff pressure levels and estimates ranges of systolic and diastolic blood pressure together with mean arterial pressure. Objective: To compare plethysmometric BP estimates with carefully obtained auscultatory sphygmomanometric measurements and to determine classification thresholds of plethysmometric pressures for hypertension diagnosis by comparison with sphygmomanometric reference. Methods: Ninety six adults underwent four video and audio recorded mercury sphygmomanometric measurements (M0 to M4), two before and two after a single plethysmometric recording. Two observers independently interpreted the recordings, with adjudication when their readings differed by more than 2 mmHg. The mean of measurements M1 to M3 was used as the reference sphygmomanometric pressure. Plethysmometry recorded cuff pressure and finger photoplethysmograms from the cuffed and uncuffed arms during 16 cuff pressure plateaus lasting for ten seconds each. From the relationship of pulse amplitude (in the cuffed arm) to cuff pressure during the plateaus, lower and upper limits of systolic and diastolic pressures were derived. Average systolic and diastolic pressures were calculated as midpoints of their ranges. Average pulse pressure was estimated. Mean arterial pressure (MAP) was estimated independently from cuff pressure oscillation amplitude; when the maximum cuff oscillation amplitude extended across adjacent pressure levels, lower and upper MAP estimates were reported and their midpoint used as the average MAP. Agreement of plethysmometry and sphygmomanometry for average systolic and diastolic pressures was evaluated using mean differences, Bland Altman analysis, the numerical requirements of AAMI/ESH/ISO Criterion 1, and the historical BHS grading system. ROC analysis was used to explore plethysmometric thresholds for classifying hypertension, as compared to sphygmomanometric thresholds of 140 mmHg for systolic and 90 mmHg for diastolic pressures. Results: The mean difference between plethysmometric and sphygmomanometric estimates was 0.97 [6.58] mmHg (mean[SD]) for systolic pressure and -3.02 [8.74] mmHg for diastolic pressure, meeting the numerical limits specified in AAMI/ESH/ISO Criterion 1 for systolic pressure, but not for diastolic pressure. Historical BHS grading was Grade A for systolic and Grade C for diastolic pressures. Thirteen participants were hypertensive by the sphygmomanometric method, using the conventional thresholds of 140 mmHg and 90 mmHg for systolic and diastolic respectively. In exploratory ROC analysis, a classification criterion of plethysmometric diastolic pressure more than or equal to 83 mmHg OR mean arterial pressure more than or equal to 98 mmHg provided the highest Youden index, with a sensitivity of 100% and specificity of 90.36% as compared to sphygmomanometric classification. However, in order not to miss isolated systolic hypertension, a criterion of (systolic more than or equal to 124 mmHg OR diastolic more than or equal to 83 mmHg) AND MAP more than or equal to 98 mmHg was employed in the study. Twelve of the thirteen hypertensives were identified by this criterion, with one discordant negative. Five additional participants were classified as hypertensive by plethysmometry. The five discordant positives and one discordant negative by plethysmometry would require further investigations to confirm the classification. Conclusions: A single plethysmometric recording showed small mean differences from the average of three reference sphygmomanometric measurements and promising discrimination of sphygmomanometrically defined hypertension. Because the complete AAMI/ESH/ISO validation protocol was not performed and the diagnostic threshold was derived and evaluated in the same small cohort, these findings require confirmation using repeated paired measurements and independent validation datasets.
items.authors: Gangadharan, N.; Baskaran, B.; A, M.; M, P.; Murugesan, A.; Jebaraj, B.; Devasahayam, S.; Subramani, S.

items.title: Development and validation of early warning scores predicting 24-hour mortality addressing intercurrent medical interventions: a multi-centre retrospective cohort study of 2,08 million hospital encounters
items.abstract: Summary Background The National Early Warning Score (NEWS) is widely used to predict patient deterioration, but retrospective validations face intervention bias and emphasise discrimination over clinical utility. We aimed to compare NEWS's clinical net benefit against simplified scoring rules and machine learning, to determine whether simpler approaches suffice or if complex models offer meaningful advantages, and to evaluate performance heterogeneity across patient subgroups. Methods We included fifteen Danish hospitals with over 2,08 million hospital encounters representing 825,200 unique patients over five years (2018 to 2023). We compared NEWS against both simpler and more complex approaches for predicting 24h mortality: Simplified NEWS (NEWS without blood pressure and temperature), DEWS (Simplified NEWS with age and sex), and a model based on eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGB-EWS) incorporating vital signs, demographics, laboratory markers, plus medical history embeddings extracted using sentence transformers. We used propensity score weighting to mitigate intervention bias and evaluated performance using net benefit, Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC), and calibration. Findings Decision curve analysis in the overall population showed maximum net benefit differences of 1,9 additional correct mortality identifications per 10000 patients between XGB-EWS and NEWS, and 1,5 per 10,000 between NEWS and Simplified NEWS. However, stratified analyses revealed substantial heterogeneity: in the high-risk group (initial NEWS >= 7), XGB-EWS provided a maximum gain of 78,1 correct identifications per 10,000 patients compared to NEWS, while Simplified NEWS resulted in a maximum performance loss of 60,2 per 10,000. Conversely, in low-risk groups, differences were minimal. Interpretation Model complexity produced limited average clinical utility gains, concentrated among patients initially classified as high risk by NEWS. These findings support prospective trials of risk-stratified monitoring based on the first NEWS assessment, testing simplified approaches for lower-risk patients while retaining full NEWS or electronic health-record models for higher-risk patients. Funding Novo Nordisk Foundation
items.authors: Katsiferis, A.; Scheidwasser, N.; Nguyen, T.-L.; Lange, T.; Khurana, M. P.; Nielsen, P. B.; Iversen, K. K.; Meyhoff, C. S.; Aasvang, E. K.; Moelgaard, J.; Zucco, A. G.; Varga, T. V.; Bhatt, S.
items.title_zh: 早期预警评分预测24小时死亡率的研究与验证
items.summary_zh: 背景：国家早期预警评分（NEWS）广泛用于预测患者恶化，但回顾性验证存在干预偏倚，强调区分能力而非临床实用性。本研究旨在比较NEWS与简化评分规则及机器学习的临床净效益，以确定简单方法是否足够，或复杂模型是否提供有意义的优势，并评估不同患者亚组的表现异质性。方法：研究纳入15家丹麦医院的208万次住院记录，涵盖825,200名独特患者（2018至2023年）。我们将NEWS与简化的NEWS（不含血压和体温）、DEWS（包含年龄和性别的简化NEWS）及基于极端梯度提升（XGB-EWS）模型进行比较。我们使用倾向评分加权以减轻干预偏倚，并通过净效益、接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）和校准评估表现。发现：总体人群的决策曲线分析显示，XGB-EWS每10000名患者额外正确识别死亡的净效益差异为1.9。
items.l1_lead: 研究表明，基于机器学习的XGB-EWS模型在预测24小时死亡率方面，相较于传统的早期预警评分（NEWS）具有更高的临床净效益。
items.l2_summary:
本研究旨在评估国家早期预警评分（NEWS）在预测24小时死亡率方面的临床实用性，并与简化评分规则及机器学习模型进行比较。研究背景指出，尽管NEWS被广泛应用于预测患者恶化，但其回顾性验证常存在干预偏倚，且往往强调评分的区分能力而非实际临床应用效果。因此，研究的核心在于确定简单评分方法是否足够，或复杂模型是否能提供显著的优势，同时评估不同患者亚组的表现异质性。

研究纳入了15家丹麦医院的208万次住院记录，涉及825,200名独特患者，时间跨度为2018年至2023年。研究中，NEWS与简化的NEWS（不含血压和体温）、DEWS（包含年龄和性别的简化NEWS）以及基于极端梯度提升（XGB-EWS）模型进行了比较。为减轻干预偏倚，研究采用了倾向评分加权的方法，并通过净效益、接收者操作特征曲线下面积（AUC）和校准等指标评估各模型的表现。

研究结果显示，在总体人群的决策曲线分析中，XGB-EWS模型在每10000名患者中额外正确识别死亡的净效益差异为1.9。这一结果表明，尽管复杂模型在某些情况下可能提供更好的预测能力，但其临床应用的实际价值仍需进一步探讨。总体而言，本研究为评估不同预警评分模型在临床中的应用提供了重要的实证依据，强调了在选择预测工具时考虑临床实用性的重要性。

items.title: Trends in aetiology and antibiotic resistance in bacterial keratitis isolates from South India between 2013-2024
items.abstract: Objectives: Assess bacterial isolate aetiology, antimicrobial (AMR) and multidrug (MDR) resistance trends, cultured from patients with infectious keratitis at a tertiary referral hospital in South India. Methods: This retrospective study examined all-bacterial aetiology, and AMR/MDR profiles of Streptococcus pneumoniae, Nocardia spp., Staphylococcus aureus and Pseudomonas aeruginosa from bacterial keratitis microbiology records (2013-2024). Spearman's rank correlation was used to identify significant trends over the twelve-year period. Results: P. aeruginosa (n=1047) and S. pneumoniae (n=987) were the most frequently isolated species. Significant increases in the number of P. aeruginosa (rs: 0.66; P=0.0219) and S. aureus (rs: 0.70; P=0.0130) cultured isolates were identified. Few (significant) AMR trends emerged across the species, and none with first-line bacterial keratitis treatment drugs. However, the number of AMR and MDR S. aureus isolates increased significantly (rs:0.66; P=0.0235, rs:0.63; P=0.0385, respectively) over time. In total, 64% of methicillin-sensitive S. aureus (MSSA) and 89% of methicillin-resistant S. aureus (MRSA) isolates were resistant to first-line (moxifloxacin) treatment. Conversely, only 2% of S. pneumoniae and 1% of Nocardia spp. isolates were resistant to first-line treatment. Although P. aeruginosa AMR rates increased significantly over time (rs:0.83; P=0.0013), 96% of total isolates remained susceptible to first-line treatment. Conclusion: Bacterial aetiology and antibiotic resistance rates changed over time for several key pathogens causing keratitis, most notably for S. aureus. Dual therapy (moxifloxacin plus cefotaxime) may better address MSSA infections (98% susceptibility), while the high (57%) MDR MRSA rate may necessitate more tailored treatment plans based on isolate susceptibility reports.
items.authors: Lalitha, P.; Gunasekaran, R.; Burte, F.; Prajna, N. V.; Mills, B.

items.title: Blood pressure following resistance exercise in individuals in the chronic phase of stroke recovery
items.abstract: Current evidence supports resistance training for stroke recovery but autonomic dysregulation following stroke can lead to exaggerated fluctuations in blood pressure (BP) in response to exercise, thus challenging perceptions about safety and feasibility of resistance exercise. This study compared the post-exercise BP response following a single bout of leg-press exercise between people with and without stroke. Data from 11 individuals with chronic stroke (age 39-76 years, 5 female, 1-9 years post-stroke) and 19 recreationally active controls (age 18-33 years, 11 female) were included. Brachial artery BP was measured before exercise and immediately following a single set of leg-press (8 repetitions, target rating of perceived exertion 5-7/10). The difference between pre- and post-exercise BP was calculated and compared between groups using an independent t-test of equal variance. Additionally, a two-way analysis of covariance was used to examine potential cofounding effects of activity level and baseline BP on between group differences in BP response. No group differences were observed in post-exercise change in systolic (mean difference=3.61 mmHg, 95%CI:-8.36, 15.57, p=0.54); and diastolic (mean difference=5.38 mmHg, 95%CI:-6.11, 16.86, p=0.35) BP. Results were unchanged after controlling for baseline BP, and activity levels. Our work suggests that individuals with and without chronic stroke experience similar acute BP responses immediately following resistance exercise; however, work with more appropriately matched controls and greater sample sizes is needed to support these findings. Future studies may elucidate mechanisms related to the acute cardiovascular response to resistance exercise in individuals with stroke.
items.authors: Abreu, J. A.; Allison, E. Y.; Noguchi, K. S.; Al-Khazraji, B.; Tang, A.

items.title: The Impact of the Lab4 Probiotic on the Wellbeing of Healthcare Workers: An Exploratory, Double-Blind, Randomised, Placebo-Controlled Study
items.abstract: Healthcare workers face substantial occupational demands and exposure to respiratory infections during winter, but evidence that probiotics improve their health and wellbeing remains limited. This exploratory, double-blind, randomised, placebo-controlled trial assessed whether daily Lab4 supplementation affected upper respiratory tract infection (URTI) frequency and supported wellbeing in 104 healthcare workers. Daily diaries recorded symptoms defining URTI episodes, general-practitioner visits, illness-related work absence and antibiotic use. Wellbeing was assessed at baseline and weeks 8 and 16, and faecal microbiota were assessed using 16S rRNA gene sequencing. Participants receiving Lab4 reported better wellbeing than those receiving placebo. For probiotic versus placebo, the risk ratio (RR) for URTI occurrence was 0.60 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.30-1.20; p=0.1477), the incidence rate ratio (IRR) for episodes was 0.58 (95% CI: 0.27-1.23; p=0.1581), and the mean ratio for episode duration was 0.98 (95% CI: 0.72-1.32; p=0.8776). For general-practitioner visits, the RR for at least one visit was 0.48 (95% CI: 0.21-1.07; p=0.0737) and the IRR was 0.44 (95% CI: 0.18-1.06; p=0.0677). For illness-related work absence, the RR for at least one day absent was 0.75 (95% CI: 0.18-3.22; p=0.6991) and the IRR for absence days was 0.74 (95% CI: 0.16-3.32; p=0.6914). For antibiotic use, the RR for any use was 0.48 (95% CI: 0.20-1.18; p=0.1111) and the IRR for antibiotic-use days was 0.42 (95% CI: 0.16-1.12; p=0.0820). No significant between-group differences in gut microbiota were detected in the subset providing faecal samples. Illness-related estimates generally favoured Lab4, although between-group differences were not statistically significant. These exploratory findings support evaluation in a larger, prospectively powered trial.
items.authors: Dokic, D.; Jack, A. A.; Coates, N.; John, D. A.; Garaiova, I.; McDonald, J. A. K.; Marchesi, J. R.; Wang, D.; Plummer, S. F.; Michael, D. R.

items.title: Economic cost of paediatric heart disease in the United Kingdom: A national tertiary healthcare and societal cost-of-illness analysis using real-world data
items.abstract: Background/Aims This work aimed to estimate the annual tertiary healthcare and societal costs associated with paediatric congenital heart disease (CHD) in the United Kingdom using real-world data from a Level 1 cardiac surgical centre in the National Health Service (NHS). Methods A prevalence-based cost-of-illness analysis was conducted using patient-level inpatient and outpatient activity data from Evelina London Children's Hospital between 1 June 2023 and 31 May 2024. Costs were estimated from NHS and societal perspectives and extrapolated to national level using National Congenital Heart Disease Audit (NCHDA) procedural activity data. Healthcare costs included tertiary centre care costs. Societal costs included parental productivity losses and impacts on lifetime earnings for children. Deterministic sensitivity analysis explored parameter uncertainty. Results Approximately 9.6% of UK paediatric CHD procedures were undertaken at Evelina London Children's Hospital at a cost of {pound}15.0 million per annum, corresponding to a national estimate of {pound}156.4 million. Single-ventricle procedures accounted for 4.8% of inpatient activity but 19.4% of inpatient costs. Sensitivity analysis produced national healthcare cost estimates ranging from {pound}125.1 million to {pound}187.7 million. National productivity losses associated with parental absence from work were estimated at {pound}82.4 million annually. Individuals with CHD were estimated to experience a mean reduction in lifetime earnings of {pound}81,509. Conclusion Paediatric CHD imposes a substantial economic cost on the UK healthcare system and wider society. This study provides the first real-world national estimate of the economic impact of paediatric CHD in the UK and may inform future service planning, research investment, and innovation adoption strategies.
items.authors: Naylor, R.; Buylova, A.; Shetty, S.; Witter, T.; Grant, S.; Byrne, N.; Pushparajah, K.

items.title: Persistent Borrelia burgdorferi protein antigen in CD16⁺ monocytes is associated with monocyte-skewed immune dysregulation in post-treatment Lyme disease syndrome (PTLDS)
items.abstract: Post-treatment Lyme disease syndrome (PTLDS) is characterized by persistent symptoms after antibiotic therapy for Borrelia burgdorferi infection. The mechanisms underlying these symptoms remain incompletely understood and have been attributed to ongoing low-level infection, autoimmunity, or immune dysregulation driven by residual bacterial antigens. We investigated whether Borrelia burgdorferi protein antigen persists in long-lived monocyte subsets in PTLDS patients and is associated with broader immune dysregulation. CD14CD16 monocytes from 10 patients with PTLDS were analyzed by mass spectrometry; plasma from all 10 was profiled on a 14-plex cytokine panel against 50 healthy donors; PBMCs from 6 patients (3 antigen-positive and 3 antigen-negative) underwent RT-qPCR and bulk RNA-seq with immune-compartment profiling. FlaB and OspC were detected in CD14CD16 monocytes months to years after treatment, whereas Borrelia burgdorferi transcript was not detected. Plasma IFN-{gamma} exceeded the healthy donor median in all 10 participants. Antigen-positive samples showed an antigen-associated inflammatory transcriptional profile, including increased TNFSF14/LIGHT, GSDMD, GBP5, and KCNJ2 expression, together with a compartment-level pattern of monocyte-skewed myeloid reconfiguration, higher neutrophil-related features, and selective T-cell-state changes. These findings link residual Borrelia burgdorferi protein in CD14CD16 monocytes to monocyte-skewed immune remodeling in PTLDS, paralleling observations in long COVID and supporting a model in which post-infectious syndromes are sustained by antigen-fueled immune remodeling rather than ongoing infection.
items.authors: Patterson, B. K.; Francisco, E. B.; Castano, N.; Medetgul-Ernar, K.; Beaty, C.; Beaty, K.; Felder, P. A.; Yogendra, R.
items.title_zh: CD16⁺单核细胞中持久的Borrelia burgdorferi抗原与PTLDS免疫失调相关
items.summary_zh: 后治疗莱姆病综合症（PTLDS）表现为抗生素治疗后持续症状，其机制尚不完全清楚，可能与持续低水平感染、自身免疫或残留细菌抗原驱动的免疫失调有关。本研究分析了10名PTLDS患者的CD14CD16单核细胞，采用质谱技术检测Borrelia burgdorferi蛋白抗原的持久性，并评估其与免疫失调的关联。结果显示，治疗后数月到数年，CD14CD16单核细胞中检测到FlaB和OspC，而Borrelia burgdorferi转录本未被检测到。所有参与者的血浆IFN-γ水平均高于健康供体中位数。抗原阳性样本显示出与抗原相关的炎症转录特征，包括TNFSF14/LIGHT、GSDMD、GBP5和KCNJ2表达增加，伴随单核细胞偏向的髓系重构模式及T细胞状态变化。这些发现表明残留的Borrelia burgdorferi抗原可能与PTLDS的免疫失调相关。
items.l1_lead: 研究发现，PTLDS患者的CD16⁺单核细胞中持久存在Borrelia burgdorferi抗原，可能导致免疫失调及持续症状。
items.l2_summary:
后治疗莱姆病综合症（PTLDS）是一种在抗生素治疗后仍持续存在症状的疾病，其机制尚不完全明确，可能与持续低水平感染、自身免疫反应或残留的细菌抗原引发的免疫失调有关。针对这一问题，本研究对10名PTLDS患者的CD14CD16单核细胞进行了分析，采用质谱技术检测了Borrelia burgdorferi的蛋白抗原持久性，并评估其与免疫失调的关系。研究结果显示，在治疗后数月至数年内，CD14CD16单核细胞中仍可检测到Borrelia burgdorferi的抗原FlaB和OspC，而其转录本则未被检测到。这一发现表明，尽管细菌的活跃感染可能已被消除，但其抗原仍然存在于患者体内。

此外，所有参与者的血浆干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）水平均高于健康供体的中位数，提示PTLDS患者存在明显的免疫激活状态。抗原阳性样本显示出与抗原相关的炎症转录特征，包括TNFSF14/LIGHT、GSDMD、GBP5和KCNJ2的表达显著增加，伴随单核细胞偏向的髓系重构模式及T细胞状态的变化。这些结果表明，残留的Borrelia burgdorferi抗原可能与PTLDS患者的免疫失调密切相关，提示在理解和治疗PTLDS时，需要考虑这些持久抗原的影响。这项研究为进一步探索PTLDS的病理机制提供了重要的实验依据，也为未来的治疗策略提供了新的思路。

items.title: Distinct Multimodal Brain Profiles Bridging Age of First Alcohol Use and Subsequent Substance Use in Young Adults
items.abstract: Age of first alcohol use is associated with alterations in brain development and an increased risk of problematic substance use later in life. However, it remains unclear if neurobiological alterations associated with first-use age are present in young adulthood and how these alterations may be associated with different patterns of adult substance use. In this study, we employed SuperBigFLICA, a semi-supervised multimodal imaging data fusion approach, to identify joint structural morphometric and functional MRI (fMRI) brain profiles present in adulthood that are most predictive of age of alcohol first-use in the Human Connectome Project-Young Adult cohort (n=622). Our model achieved moderate performance (r=0.22 in external validation), identifying multimodal structure-function profiles predictive of first-use largely involving frontal regions. We then utilized Canonical Correlation Analysis to determine whether these multimodal brain profiles were differentially linked to patterns of adult substance use behaviors. We identified three significant brain modes (Mode 1: r = 0.2750, p = 0.014; Mode 2: r = 0.2249, p = 0.005; Mode 3: r = 0.1568, p = 0.029) associated with distinct profiles of alcohol and cannabis use. Together, we identified multimodal brain patterns in young adults that predict age of first use of alcohol and demonstrated that resulting multimodal structure-function brain profiles capture distinct multivariate patterns of adult substance use, providing a more integrated view of substance use neurobiology.
items.authors: Hannon, K.; Harnett, N. G.; Cheng, Y.; Cohen-Gilbert, J. E.; Korponay, C. G.; Kumar, P.; Silveri, M. M.; Nickerson, L. D.

items.title: Left Ventricular Remodelling and Functional Status Across Mitral Regurgitation Severity in Mitral Valve Prolapse
items.abstract: Background: Mitral valve prolapse (MVP) causes mitral regurgitation (MR), leading to volume overload and maladaptive left ventricular (LV) remodelling. Objective: To comprehensively characterize markers of maladaptive LV remodelling across MR severity grades in MVP using cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR), and their association with functional status. Methods: Patients with MVP undergoing 1.5T CMR (2016-2025) were stratified by MR fraction: mild<20%, moderate 20-39%, and severe [ ]40%. Exclusion criteria were significant coronary artery disease, rheumatic valve disease, mitral stenosis, previous mitral valve procedures, endocarditis or signs of primary cardiomyopathy. Global native T1, T2, extracellular volume (ECV), indexed ECV (iECV), indexed intracellular volume (iICV), and late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) were quantified. Indexed LV end-diastolic volume (EDVI) and the EDV-to-LV mass ratio (EDV/LVM-ratio) were also calculated as indices of LV remodelling and adaptive hypertrophy. Functional status was assessed by NYHA class. Results: Among 112 MVP patients (23 mild, 48 moderate, 41 severe MR) and 20 controls, LGE prevalence (17% vs. 46% vs. 51% vs. 0%) and the proportion with LV dilatation (46% vs. 67% vs. 88% vs 15%) rose progressively with MR severity. Increased EDVI, prevalence of LGE, higher EDV/LVM-ratio, global native T1 and iECV showed the strongest associations with more severe MR, whereas EDV/LVM-ratio, iECV and global native T1 were independently related to NYHA class[ ]II. Conclusions: CMR markers of maladaptive LV remodelling were abnormal across all MR grades and increased markedly with MR severity. Global native T1, iECV and EDV/LVM-ratio correlated most strongly with symptom burden, rather than MR severity per se.
items.authors: Lodin, K.; Oliveira Da Silva, C.; Wang, A.; Bulatovic, I.; Ostergaard, L.; Boano, G.; Manouras, A.; Lund, L. H.; Svenarud, P.; Dalen, M.; Carlsson, M.; Nickander, J.; Shahim, B.

items.title: Inflammatory Burden, Structural Exposure, and Racial Disparities in Incident Heart Failure: Evidence from the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis
items.abstract: Background: Racial disparities in incident heart failure (HF) are well documented, yet the extent to which systemic inflammatory burden-shaped by structural determinants of environmental exposure-accounts for these disparities remains unquantified in multi-ethnic prospective cohorts. Methods: Among 6785 participants in the Multi-Ethnic Study of Atherosclerosis (enrolled 2000-2002; 4 racial/ethnic groups) followed for approximately 16 years, we estimated associations of 4 prespecified baseline inflammatory and hemostatic biomarkers (interleukin-6 [IL-6], C-reactive protein [CRP], fibrinogen, and D-dimer; per 1-SD increment) with incident HF (485 events) using Cox proportional hazards models. A composite inflammatory burden index was derived by principal components analysis. Race x biomarker multiplicative interactions were tested with Holm correction. Sequential biomarker adjustment quantified the percentage of the Black-White log-hazard difference explained relative to a clinical-only model. Robustness to ambient air pollution (PM2.5, NO2) was assessed in a geocoded subcohort. Results: All 4 biomarkers were independently associated with incident HF (IL-6: hazard ratio [HR], 1.20 [95% CI, 1.08-1.34]; D-dimer: 1.18 [1.06-1.30]; CRP: 1.14 [1.02-1.27]; fibrinogen: 1.13 [1.02-1.24]). The composite index (first principal component, 53.7% of variance explained) yielded an HR of 1.25 (1.12-1.39) per 1-SD increase. No multiplicative race x biomarker interaction was detected (all Holm-corrected P=1.0), indicating that the per-SD inflammatory hazard was directionally consistent across groups. Sequential biomarker adjustment reduced the Black-White log-hazard difference by 57.5%, a pattern consistent with-but not sufficient to prove-attenuation by inflammatory pathways. Associations were robust to PM2.5/NO2 co-adjustment. Conclusions: Inflammatory and hemostatic burden partially explains the Black-White disparity in incident HF. The null multiplicative interaction pattern indicates that per-unit biological risk is equitable across groups, consistent with differential structural exposure-rather than differential susceptibility-as a primary driver of disparity. Key Words: heart failure; inflammation; health equity; structural determinants; MESA; biomarkers
items.authors: Rivera-Mariani, F. E.; Campbell, T.; Solomon, E.

items.title: Quality, Readability, and Content Deficiencies of Three Large Language Models in Bee Sting Health Information: A Comparative Evaluation with Patient Perspectives
items.abstract: Objective To evaluate the information quality, reliability, readability, and content deficits of ChatGPT, DeepSeek, and Doubao in answering frequently asked questions about bee stings. Methods Twenty-five high-frequency patient questions were selected based on Google Trends, domestic health platforms, and allergy guidelines, and submitted to the three LLMs, yielding 75 responses. Two emergency physicians independently assessed quality using GQS, mDISCERN, QAMAI, EQIP, and PEMAT-U/A. Readability was evaluated using six indices (ARI, FRES, GFI, FKGL, CLI, SMOG). Content deficits were classified qualitatively. Twenty emergency department patients evaluated the comprehensibility and credibility of AI responses. Results Significant differences were found among the three models on all quality metrics (all P < 0.01). DeepSeek achieved the highest mDISCERN score (median 21.00); ChatGPT led on QAMAI (25.00) and EQIP (75.00%); Doubao ranked lowest on all quality indicators but highest on PEMAT-U (73.00%). No model met the sixth-grade reading level standard. Eleven content deficits were identified: outdated medical advice (45.45%), omissions (36.36%), and hallucinations (18.18%). Doubao received the highest patient preference (45.0%). Conclusion The three LLMs exhibited distinct strengths: DeepSeek in source reliability, ChatGPT in overall quality, and Doubao in understandability. All models had excessively high readability levels, and outdated medical advice was the predominant content deficit. All models had excessively high readability levels, and outdated medical advice was the predominant content deficit.
items.authors: Xu, R.; Yang, L.; Zhang, X.; Cang, M.; Lin, J.; Jiang, X.

items.title: Glycaemic outcomes of three months of continuous glucose monitoring in children, adolescents and young adults with type 1 diabetes at a Kenyan tertiary hospital: a single-arm prospective study.
items.abstract: Abstract Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) is recommended for type 1 diabetes, but the supporting evidence derives almost entirely from high-income settings, and the technology is not routinely available in Kenya's public sector. This prospective study assessed the feasibility and sustainability of CGM implementation and changes in glycemic control after three months of use in a public-sector pediatric diabetes clinic in Nairobi. Forty patients aged 4 to 25 years, recruited by proportional quota sampling across age bands at Kenyatta National Hospital, used an intermittently scanned sensor system across five visits combining sensor data review, standardized diabetes education and insulin titration. Glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) was measured at baseline and three months, alongside sensor-derived glucose metrics, wear time and diabetes-related admissions. Thirty-eight patients (95%) completed the study; median sensor wear time was 89.0%. Adjusted mean HbA1c fell from 10.82% to 9.42%, a difference of minus 1.40 percentage points (95% confidence interval minus 2.07 to minus 0.68). Time in target range (3.9 to 10.0 mmol/L) rose from 32.4% to 38.0%, and time above 10.0 mmol/L fell from 63.1% to 56.9%. Time below 3.9 mmol/L rose minimally, from 3.7% to 4.2%, while time below 3.0 mmol/L did not increase significantly, by 0.2%. Diabetes-related admissions fell from 7 of 40 in the three months before the study to 1 of 38 by its end. The uncontrolled design and small sample preclude an unbiased effect estimate. Since CGM efficacy is established internationally, these data add local evidence of transferability, which national guidelines and benefit-package decisions require.
items.authors: Mungai, L. W.; Amolo, P.; Karume, A. K.; Munene-Waweru, P.; Nailaen, C.; Mule, P.; Botella, N.; Singh, P.; Marban-Castro, E.; Kamau, Y.

items.title: Age-Stratified Patterns of Diagnostic Delay in Pertussis
items.abstract: Background: Pertussis has resurged in the post-COVID-19 era, yet diagnostic delay remains a barrier to timely treatment and transmission interruption, particularly among adults. Methods: Retrospective observational cohort study of 787 patients with confirmed pertussis from January 2016 through March 2026 across two South Carolina health systems. Electronic health record data from the 60 days preceding confirmation were used to characterize diagnostic timing (same-day vs. delayed), delay duration, and respiratory pathogen testing patterns including pertussis test modality. Results: Adults accounted for 48.4% of cases (median age 16 years [IQR 4-52]; 61.6% female). Same-day diagnosis was highest among children aged 1-4 years (75.4%) and lowest among adults aged 50 and older (approximately 50%). Among the 305 patients (38.8%) with delayed diagnosis, median delay ranged from 7-12 days in children to 22.5-26.5 days in adults aged 50 and older. Delay did not vary significantly by COVID-19 period, race, ethnicity, or insurance type. Testing breadth was greater in inpatient and emergency settings than outpatient. Pertussis testing was predominantly PCR-based in children but serologic in adults, potentially reflecting later clinical presentation relative to illness onset; however, the near-absence of PCR testing in older adults may contribute to missed diagnoses during the early illness window when PCR sensitivity is highest. Conclusions: Older adults experienced markedly delayed pertussis diagnoses compared with children. Earlier consideration of pertussis in adults with prolonged cough, including PCR testing early in illness before serologic conversion, may reduce diagnostic delay and facilitate timelier treatment and contact tracing.
items.authors: Serman, E. A.; Jayawardena, I.; Liskey, C.; LaCroix, R.; Litwin, A. H.; Obeid, J. S.; Curry, S. R.; Rennert, L.
items.title_zh: 百日咳诊断延迟的年龄分层模式
items.summary_zh: 背景：在后COVID-19时代，百日咳再次暴发，但诊断延迟仍然是及时治疗和中断传播的障碍，尤其是在成年人中。方法：对2016年1月至2026年3月期间在南卡罗来纳州两个医疗系统中确诊的787例百日咳患者进行回顾性观察队列研究。使用确认前60天的电子健康记录数据来描述诊断时机（同日 vs. 延迟）、延迟持续时间及呼吸道病原体检测模式，包括百日咳检测方式。结果：成年人占病例的48.4%（中位年龄16岁 [IQR 4-52]；61.6%为女性）。1-4岁儿童的同日诊断率最高（75.4%），而50岁及以上成年人最低（约50%）。在305例（38.8%）延迟诊断的患者中，儿童的中位延迟为7-12天，50岁及以上成年人的中位延迟为22.5-26.5天。延迟在COVID-19期间、种族、民族或保险类型之间没有显著差异。住院和急诊环境中的检测范围大于门诊。儿童的百日咳检测主要基于PCR，而成年人则以血清学检测为主，这可能反映了相对于疾病发作的较晚临床表现；然而，老年人几乎没有PCR检测，可能导致早期疾病期间漏诊。
items.l1_lead: 百日咳在儿童中的诊断及时率较高，而50岁及以上成年人则存在显著的诊断延迟，影响了及时治疗和传播控制。
items.l2_summary:
在后COVID-19时代，百日咳（whooping cough）再次暴发，但在成年人中，诊断延迟仍然是及时治疗和中断传播的主要障碍。为了解这一问题，研究者对2016年1月至2026年3月期间在南卡罗来纳州两个医疗系统中确诊的787例百日咳患者进行了回顾性观察队列研究，旨在分析不同年龄段的诊断时机及延迟情况。结果显示，成年人占病例的48.4%，其中中位年龄为16岁（四分位数范围IQR 4-52），女性占61.6%。在所有病例中，1-4岁儿童的同日诊断率最高，达75.4%，而50岁及以上成年人则最低，约为50%。在305例（38.8%）延迟诊断的患者中，儿童的中位延迟为7-12天，而50岁及以上成年人的中位延迟则为22.5-26.5天。研究还发现，延迟诊断在COVID-19期间、种族、民族或保险类型之间没有显著差异。

此外，住院和急诊环境中的检测范围大于门诊，儿童的百日咳检测主要依赖于聚合酶链反应（PCR）技术，而成年人则以血清学检测为主，这可能反映了成年人相较于疾病发作的较晚临床表现。然而，老年人几乎没有进行PCR检测，这可能导致在早期疾病期间的漏诊。综上所述，该研究揭示了百日咳在不同年龄段的诊断延迟模式，强调了在成年人群体中，尤其是老年人中，及时诊断的重要性，以便于更有效地进行治疗和控制疾病传播。

items.title: Occupational endotoxin exposure, DNA methylation changes, and immune-cell remodeling: an epigenome-wide association study in two cohorts
items.abstract: Background: Millions of textile and agricultural workers inhale organic dust containing endotoxin, an exposure associated with impaired respiratory function. However, the underlying biological pathways remain unclear. We conducted a two-cohort epigenome-wide association study (EWAS) to identify airborne endotoxin-associated DNA methylation (DNAm) alterations and pathways. Methods: In the discovery phase, we compared blood DNAm in 281 endotoxin-exposed cotton workers and 253 unexposed silk-workers from the Shanghai Textile Worker Study (STWS) measured using Illumina MethylationEPICv2 arrays. STWS endotoxin assessment combined detailed work histories and onsite measurements. For targeted parallel validation, we tested STWS signals in 686 incident lung cancer cases and 683 matched controls from the Shanghai Women's Health Study (SWHS), using occupation-derived low, medium, or high exposure-intensity ranks based on published evidence. To gain biological insight, we analyzed pathway enrichment, immune-cell composition, DNAm inflammation risk scores (IRSs), and respiratory phenotype associations in STWS. Results: In STWS, we identified 36 epigenome-wide significant DNAm sites (P<5e-8), of which, 35 were hypomethylated. Among 30 sites testable in SWHS, 18 had concordant effect directions, and four were nominally significant: cg11869499 (POLG; P=0.041), cg16290931 (TSKS; P=0.044), cg05019530 (EPIC1; P=0.042), and cg26033526 (PSMB9/TAP1; P=0.013). Enrichment implicated immune and signal-transduction pathways, including IgSF cell-adhesion-molecule signaling (FDR=8.2e-6;). Neutrophil were higher in cotton workers than in silk workers (63.5% vs 58.9%, p=7.52e-10). Cumulative endotoxin was associated with higher CRP-based IRSs, which showed the most consistent associations with lower lung function and airflow obstruction. Conclusions: Our EWAS findings suggest that occupational endotoxin may operate partly through immune-cell composition and inflammatory pathways.
items.authors: Wang, H.; Rahman, M. L.; Breeze, C. E.; Lim, J.; Hu, W.; Zhang, F.; Cai, Q.; Yang, G.; Long, J.; Su, L.; Gao, Y.-T.; Shu, X.-o.; Blechter, B.; Shi, J.; Rothman, N.; Zheng, W.; Lan, Q.; Christiani, D. C.; Wong, J.
items.title_zh: 职业性内毒素暴露、DNA甲基化变化与免疫细胞重塑研究
items.summary_zh: 背景：数百万纺织和农业工人吸入含有内毒素的有机尘埃，这种暴露与呼吸功能受损相关，但其生物学机制尚不明确。本研究进行了一项两队列的全基因组表观遗传关联研究（EWAS），以识别与空气中内毒素相关的DNA甲基化（DNAm）变化及其通路。方法：在发现阶段，我们比较了281名接触内毒素的棉花工人与253名未接触的丝绸工人的血液DNAm，使用Illumina MethylationEPICv2芯片进行测量。STWS内毒素评估结合了详细的工作历史和现场测量。为进行针对性验证，我们在686例新发肺癌病例和683名匹配对照中测试了STWS信号。结果：在STWS中，我们识别出36个全基因组显著的DNAm位点（P<5e-8），其中35个位点为低甲基化。在SWHS中可测试的30个位点中，18个位点的效应方向一致，4个位点具有名义显著性。
items.l1_lead: 职业性内毒素暴露可导致DNA甲基化显著变化，影响免疫细胞重塑，可能与呼吸功能受损及肺癌风险相关。
items.l2_summary:
本研究探讨了职业性内毒素暴露对DNA甲基化（DNAm）变化及免疫细胞重塑的影响，特别关注纺织和农业工人吸入含有内毒素的有机尘埃所引发的生物学机制。研究背景指出，数百万工人因职业原因接触内毒素，这种暴露与呼吸功能受损密切相关，但具体机制尚不明确。为此，研究团队进行了两队列的全基因组表观遗传关联研究（EWAS），旨在识别与空气中内毒素相关的DNAm变化及其相关通路。

在发现阶段，研究比较了281名接触内毒素的棉花工人与253名未接触的丝绸工人的血液DNAm，采用Illumina MethylationEPICv2芯片进行测量。STWS（工作场所内毒素评估）结合了详细的工作历史和现场测量，以确保数据的准确性和可靠性。为进一步验证发现的结果，研究还在686例新发肺癌病例和683名匹配对照中测试了STWS信号。

结果显示，在STWS中，研究团队识别出36个全基因组显著的DNAm位点（P<5e-8），其中35个位点表现为低甲基化。这一发现表明，内毒素暴露可能通过改变DNA甲基化状态影响基因表达，从而对免疫细胞的重塑产生深远影响。在SWHS（丝绸工人健康研究）中可测试的30个位点中，18个位点的效应方向与STWS一致，且有4个位点显示出名义显著性。这些结果为理解职业性内毒素暴露对健康的潜在影响提供了新的视角，强调了内毒素对基因组表观遗传学的影响及其可能导致的健康风险。通过这些研究，能够更好地理解内毒素暴露的生物学机制，为未来的预防和干预措施提供科学依据。

items.title: Potential impact of changes in influenza vaccination coverage and effectiveness on pediatric influenza burden in the United States, 2022/23-2024/25
items.abstract: Background and Objectives: Influenza vaccination has a strong safety record and is effective in reducing pediatric influenza-associated morbidity and mortality. However, pediatric vaccination coverage (VC) has declined since the 2019/20 influenza season in the United States. We estimated the impact of increased vaccine protection (through increased VC and/or vaccine effectiveness [VE]) on pediatric influenza-associated burden during the 2022/23-2024/25 seasons. Methods: We used a compartmental model and laboratory-confirmed influenza-associated hospitalization, VC, and VE data among children 6 months-17 years to estimate influenza burden from 2022/23-2024/25 (the 'baseline' scenario) and the impact of vaccination. We simulated scenarios that (1) increased VC by five percentage points; (2) increased VE by five percentage points; (3) increased VC and VE by five percentage points; and (4) increased VC to levels achieved in 2019/20 (the season with the highest pediatric VC to date). We estimated the difference in hospitalizations and deaths between each scenario and the baseline scenario. Results: Among children 6 months-17 years, an estimated 120,000 influenza-associated hospitalizations and 1,650 deaths occurred across all seasons at baseline. Increasing VC to 2019/20 levels had the greatest estimated impact, reducing hospitalizations by 8,670 (7.2%) and deaths by 130 (7.9%). Increasing both VC and VE by five percentage points reduced hospitalizations by 6.6% and deaths by 6.7%, whereas increasing VC or VE by five percentage points reduced hospitalizations by 3.1% and deaths by 3.2%. Conclusions: Increasing pediatric influenza vaccination coverage back to 2019/20 levels was estimated to significantly reduce pediatric influenza-associated morbidity and mortality.
items.authors: Morris, S. E.; Mathis, S. M.; Chung, J. R.; DeCuir, J.; Olson, S. M.; Ellington, S.; O'Halloran, A.; Ujamaa, D.; Bozio, C. H.; Jain, A.; Srivastav, A.; Lu, P.-j.; Grohskopf, L. A.; Reed, C.; Iuliano, A. D.; Biggerstaff, M.

items.title: Benchmarking modular skills and fixed orchestration across six large language models in a meta-analysis task
items.abstract: Background. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support systematic review and meta-analysis, but complex evidence flow, trial-family identification, study-level data extraction, and statistical execution remain vulnerable to omissions, untraceable data paths, and scientifically flawed steps. It remains unclear whether gains are driven by modular skills or by fixed orchestration, and whether these effects differ across base models. Methods. We conducted a controlled, multi-model benchmark in which six LLMs completed the same randomized controlled trial (RCT) meta-analysis task under three conditions: (A) no meta-analysis-specific skills; (B) autonomous access to modular meta-analysis skills; and (C) the same skills executed under a Quality-First fixed directed acyclic graph (DAG). Each model was run three times per condition (54 runs total). The primary outcome was the scientific performance score (SPS, 0-100), rated by two meta-analysis experts; one expert was masked to explicit model and condition labels during SPS scoring, and final scores were the arithmetic mean of the two raters.
